verdict.rationale: Kong's architecture is API-first: the Admin API (and declarative config via decK) can configure everything, and Kong Manager UI is described as just one way to configure Kong alongside the Admin API/decK, plus Konnect exposes an OpenAPI directory for its platform APIs. This strongly implies API/UI parity, and decK's CLI is verified hands-on (kong-probe-4). However, no evidence explicitly confirms 1:1 feature parity between Kong Manager/Konnect UI and the Admin/Konnect APIs, nor is this claim independently verified. missing for 10: explicit parity documentation or audit confirming every UI action has an API equivalent, independent verification of full UI/API feature equivalence.
